tutorial.foundations: Eight foundations. The left four build up from the aces, the right four down from the kings; two decks (104 cards) fit exactly. They start **empty** - an ace or king founds its pile when it turns up.
tutorial.stock: **There is no waste.** Pressing the stock enters a deal mode: choose a reserve slot, or a foundation that accepts the card. A card sent straight to a foundation does not count toward the twenty.
tutorial.tableau: Twenty reserve slots. **Until twenty cards have been dealt, the reserve cannot feed the foundations at all.** A placed card buries what is under it, and **an empty slot is never refilled** - choosing where to bury is the whole game.
tutorial.controls: Buttons for dealing, hints and undo.

dealAria: Deal one card from the stock (you choose where it goes)
